createCampaignPreset.description: Sets up the new draft in the same call: its goal and end date, its donation form's suggested amounts (at most 6), and the theme's starter story for the operator to replace. recommend_campaign_presets suggests the values. Left out, only the draft is created.

goal.description: An object with a decimal-string amount and a currency, such as {"amount": "100.00", "currency": "USD"}. A plain number is refused.

items.description: An object with a decimal-string amount and a currency, such as {"amount": "100.00", "currency": "USD"}. A plain number is refused.

addedTools.name: get_profile
addedTools.title: Get the connected account
addedTools.description: Returns the connected Better Giving account: a stable id for it and the nonprofit's name.

addedTools.name: recommend_campaign_presets
addedTools.title: Recommend campaign settings
addedTools.description: Recommends a new campaign's goal, suggested amounts, run length (endDays, days from publish to the end date) and theme from the nonprofit's ended campaigns and its gifts, each with a sentence of evidence. With little history, each is the theme's starting point and basedOnHistory is false. Use the values as create_campaign's preset, with end_date endDays after today.

theme.description: Recommend for this kind of appeal rather than the one history points to.

addedTools.name: show_campaign_create
addedTools.title: Show the campaign presets
addedTools.description: Shows the operator a card to start a campaign from a preset (emergency, year-end, capital or giving day), with values recommended from their past campaigns. Use it when they want a new campaign and haven't named the details. The card creates the draft itself.

addedTools.name: show_campaigns
addedTools.title: Show campaigns
addedTools.description: Shows the operator their campaigns as cards with status and progress toward each goal (up to eight). Use it to browse campaigns; the cards open each campaign's results or editor.

addedTools.name: show_campaign_results
addedTools.title: Show a campaign's results
addedTools.description: Shows the operator one campaign's results card: raised against its goal, donors, average and median gift, and the last seven days against the seven before; a draft shows what is left before it can be published. The card has the Publish and End buttons; End asks the operator to confirm in the card, Publish doesn't.

addedTools.name: open_campaign_editor
addedTools.title: Open a campaign's editor
addedTools.description: Opens the fullscreen editor for a campaign's page, with a live preview of the donation page. Its saves go to the site at once: donors see a live campaign's edits as soon as they're saved.

addedTools.name: show_photo
addedTools.title: Show a campaign's photo
addedTools.description: Shows a campaign's cover photo and, when the operator dropped a photo into the chat, a card to set it as the cover.

addedTools.name: set_campaign_photo
addedTools.title: Set a campaign's cover photo
addedTools.description: Sets a campaign's cover photo from a photo the operator dropped into the chat (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 4 MB). If it can't be set here, the answer carries a one-time link for the operator to upload it themselves. An ended campaign takes no new photo.

addedTools.name: app_create_campaign
addedTools.title: Create a campaign draft from a preset
addedTools.description: The campaign presets card's Create draft button: makes a draft campaign with the preset's goal, end date, suggested amounts and starter story. Only the card calls this tool, when the operator presses its button; never call it from the chat.

annotations.title: Create a campaign draft from a preset

addedTools.name: app_publish_campaign
addedTools.title: Publish a campaign from its card
addedTools.description: The results card's Publish button: puts a draft campaign live, or sends a live campaign's saved draft edits. Only the card calls this tool, when the operator presses its button; never call it from the chat.

annotations.title: Publish a campaign from its card

addedTools.name: app_end_campaign
addedTools.title: End a campaign from its card
addedTools.description: The results card's End campaign button, pressed after its inline confirm: ends the campaign for good; it stops taking gifts. Only the card calls this tool, when the operator presses its button; never call it from the chat.

annotations.title: End a campaign from its card

addedTools.name: app_get_campaign_editor
addedTools.title: Reload a campaign in the editor
addedTools.description: The editor's refresh: the campaign's page, draft included. Only the card calls this tool, when the operator presses its button; never call it from the chat.

annotations.title: Reload a campaign in the editor

addedTools.name: app_save_campaign_edit
addedTools.title: Save an editor change
addedTools.description: The editor's save: writes the change to the site at once, a live campaign's included. Only the card calls this tool, when the operator presses its button; never call it from the chat.

addedTools.name: app_set_campaign_photo
addedTools.title: Set a cover photo from its card
addedTools.description: The photo card's Set as cover: uploads the dropped photo as the campaign's cover. Only the card calls this tool, when the operator presses its button; never call it from the chat.

annotations.title: Set a cover photo from its card

addedTools.name: app_photo_upload_link
addedTools.title: Get an upload link from the photo card
addedTools.description: The photo card's Open upload link: a single-use link, good for 15 minutes, to upload the campaign's cover on the site. Only the card calls this tool, when the operator presses its button; never call it from the chat.

annotations.title: Get an upload link from the photo card
